name: Chizu Akane
source:
akifumi's older sister. She dotes on her younger brother.

“My brother might get a girlfriend”
　　　　↓
“I don't want to give him up”
　　　　↓
“Before that happens—”

Driven by this thought, she fiercely pursues her brother.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/axh/axh_chr.html#akane]official site[/url]]
